_about: Source of truth for WeBuddhist tags. Key is facet/value (lowercase ascii, one slash). The backend tag model is flat (title + description only), so the key is written as the first line of the description and mirrored here with the backend id once created. Renaming a tag on the backend means delete + recreate + re-attach: change keys here only before creation.

practice/chant.description: Texts recited as practice in the WeBuddhist app; drives the Chants screen. Replaces the use of the Liturgy category for that purpose.

tradition/theravada.description: Buddhist tradition of the text, mirroring the app's onboarding choice 'Pāli scriptures'. Applied to root texts; the backend cascades it to their translations.

tradition/mahayana.description: Buddhist tradition of the text, mirroring the app's onboarding choice 'Chinese scriptures'. Applied to root texts; the backend cascades it to their translations.

tradition/vajrayana.description: Buddhist tradition of the text, mirroring the app's onboarding choice 'Sanskrit & Tibetan scriptures'. Applied to root texts; the backend cascades it to their translations.
